target.title: Targets
target.description: Credentials go straight into the encrypted vault and are never returned by the API, written to logs or put in a backup exported without secrets.
target.endpoint_webhook_description: The http(s) address the signed JSON is posted to.
target.endpoint_smtp_description: Host name of the mail server.
target.endpoint_apprise_description: For display only — the full target URL carries the token and stays in the vault.
target.secret_webhook_description: Used for the HMAC header a receiver verifies; it never travels itself.
target.secret_apprise_description: For example tgram://token/chat_id — handed to apprise in its environment, never as an argument.
target.secret_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
target.delete_description: Delete the target "{name}"? Its rules go with it.
target.endpoint_plugin_description: Where this plugin sends: an ntfy topic or the full address of your own ntfy server (https; http only inside your own network), a Telegram chat id, or whatever the plugin asks for. Never a token.
target.secret_plugin_description: The token this destination authenticates with. It goes into the vault and the plugin never sees it — only the request it builds carries it.
target.destination_description: Which installed destination delivers this target.

smtp.port_description: Empty picks 587, 465 or 25 to match the encryption.

rule.title: Rules
rule.description: A rule routes matching events to one target. Each event produces at most one delivery per rule, even after a restart.
rule.category_description: Restricts the rule to one category; events without a category are then skipped.

history.title: Delivery history
history.description: Every attempt with its response. Responses are truncated and redacted, so no secret ends up here.
